BiblicalUsage: Nebuchadnezzar shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes break down thy towers, says Ezekiel to Tyre. The word is the battering-ram itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tyre's walls could not stand against the engines God sent, and the battering-ram is his instrument.
